THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: 9/3/1/1/3/6. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: 4-3/4/2012/D-43.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/Servitude* which is required for a Public purpose.
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired :

An allotments of land in extent of 3.0903 Hectares shown as Lot No. 67-79 in Cadastral Map No. 510028 (zone 4) and paper 7, Prepared by Surveyor General, dated of 03.10.2017, situated in the Village of Kithulwala Ihalagama in 43/A - Kithulwala Ihala Grama Niladhari Division, in Divisional Secretarial Division at Divulapitiya, in the District of Gampaha in Western Province.

1. Lot No. 67 Name of the land: Kithulwala Kanda; Description: Home Garden, 3 Teak trees nearly 35 years old, 28 Coconut trees, 7 Mango trees, 2 Jak trees and a permanent building and lavatory; Claimant: Morawaththage Kamalawathie of No. 47/7, Ihalagama, Kithulwala; Land Extent 0.3856 Hectare.

Ranasinghe of No. 47, Ihalagama, Kithulwala; Land Extent 0.2911 Hectare.

Lot No. 70 Name of the land: Kithulwala Kanda; Description: Home Garden, 13 Teak trees nearly 30 years old, 18 Coconut trees, 8 Mango trees, 6 Jak trees, 25 Attoniya trees and a temporary building; Claimant: Hewathilaka Pedige Leelawathie of No. 47/6, Ihalagama, Kithulwala; Land Extent 0.2911 Hectare.

5. Lot No. 71 Name of the land: Kithulwala Kanda; Description: Home Garden, 6 Teak trees nearly 30 years old, 12 Jak trees, 2 Mango trees; Claimant: M. P. Siriwardhane of No. 57/A, Ihalagama, Kithulwala, who is the Heir of deceased I. P. Emalin; Land Extent 0.3787 Hectare.
